release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.6 Fluent Settings Left Sidebar, Instant Search, HDR Mica & Documents Output:
• Windows 11 Settings App Left-Sidebar Rail: Categorized navigation across Chairs, Strands, CAD Blocks, Schedules & Output, QA, and System.
• Real-Time Instant Search: Instantly filter all configuration settings with live dynamic card packing.
• Small-Screen & Laptop Responsive Scaling: Dynamic percentage-based card width and adaptive height expansion preventing text overflow on high-DPI displays.
• Native Windows 11 Mica & Mica Alt with HDR: Translucent backdrop material works seamlessly with HDR displays enabled.
• Default Documents Output Directory: Saved drawings and schedules default to Documents\VortexPT, eliminating AutoCAD UAC read-only lock issues.
• Tendon Parabola & Cache Resolution: Corrected anchor start elevation calculation and automated cache invalidation ensuring smooth parabolic profiling.
